answer_md: Tenorwise cannot forecast rates. It shows what happens under the scenarios it prices.
verification_rule: Every number in an answer is checked against the engine before it is shown. A tagged number must equal the cited value's display string, or be that value correctly rounded to the printed precision and within 0.5% of it; an explicit sign must match. An untagged number must be a context number (a tool argument, tenor, shock size, hedge ratio, horizon or date). One failure blocks the answer.
